Klasse GameUtils.Analysis

java.lang.Object
feu.agenten.shogo_seifert.GameUtils.Analysis
Umschließende Klasse:
GameUtils
public static class GameUtils.Analysis extends Object
Collection of helper methods related to analytical operations on the ring.

The collection includes getting a list of a specific type of nodes, colony related helper methods, or getting the strongest node out of a list of nodes.

    • getColonies

      public static List<List<Node>> getColonies(List<Node> ring, String owner)
      Returns a list of "colonies". Colonies are connected nodes owned by the given owner.

      If the first and last colonies belong to the same owner, they are merged into a single colony.

      The list of colonies is sorted in ascending order base on the colony size.

      Parameter:
      ring - a list of Nodes that is forming the ring
      owner - the owner of the colonies
      Gibt zurück:
      a list of colonies, represented as a list of Nodes, sorted by ascending colony size

    • allVisibleNodes

      Parameter:
      myNodes - a list of owned Nodes

      Gibt zurück:
      a list, merged out of the three given lists (result is a list containing all visible Nodes)
